hook: Tandem Diabetes Care recalled 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps over false occlusion alarms suspending delivery.

sections.voiceover: Tandem Diabetes Care recalled 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps over false occlusion alarms suspending delivery.
On September 23, 2026, Tandem Diabetes Care recalled 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps. Why did these Mobi drive modules trigger false occlusion alarms?
Worse, Tandem Diabetes Care received 230 adverse event reports requiring medical intervention from false alarms.
Increased friction within the Mobi pump's drive module reduces power, causing false occlusion alarms. Tandem Diabetes Care documented 230 adverse events linked to this hardware failure.
That leaves 80,000 Mobi insulin pumps requiring correction.
